# Meus resultado

```{r}

df_sample_size_30_otim <- read_csv("simulacoes_23_05/df_sample_size_30_otim.csv")
df_sample_size_60_otim <- read_csv("simulacoes_23_05/df_sample_size_60_otim.csv")
df_sample_size_200_otim <- read_csv("simulacoes_23_05/df_sample_size_200_otim.csv")
df_sample_size_500_otim <- read_csv("simulacoes_23_05/df_sample_size_500_otim.csv")
```

```{r}

df_long_size_30 <- df_sample_size_30_otim %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(variance, bias, mse),
               names_to = "Measures",
               values_to = "Value")

# Agora pivotar para formato largo como o outro dataframe
df_size_30 <- df_long_size_30 %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = Value)

df_size_30
```

```{r}

df_long_size_60 <- df_sample_size_60_otim %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(variance, bias, mse),
               names_to = "Measures",
               values_to = "Value")

# Agora pivotar para formato largo como o outro dataframe
df_size_60 <- df_long_size_60 %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = Value)

df_size_60
```

```{r}

df_long_size_200 <- df_sample_size_200_otim %>%

               values_to = "Value")

# Agora pivotar para formato largo como o outro dataframe
```

```{r}
df_long_size_500 <- df_sample_size_500_otim %>%
```

# P-values

p value \> 0,05 indica que não tem grandes diferenças

```{r}

t.test(df_size_30$Gaussian, df_table2$Gaussian)$p.value
t.test(df_size_30$Laplace, df_table2$Laplace)$p.value
t.test(df_size_30$Cauchy, df_table2$Cauchy)$p.value
t.test(df_size_30$Pareto, df_table2$Pareto)$p.value
t.test(df_size_30$NND, df_table2$NND)$p.value
t.test(df_size_30$SS, df_table2$SS)$p.value
```

```{r}

t.test(df_size_60$Gaussian, df_table3$Gaussian)$p.value
t.test(df_size_60$Laplace, df_table3$Laplace)$p.value
t.test(df_size_60$Cauchy, df_table3$Cauchy)$p.value
t.test(df_size_60$Pareto, df_table3$Pareto)$p.value
t.test(df_size_60$NND, df_table3$NND)$p.value
t.test(df_size_60$SS, df_table3$SS)$p.value
```

```{r}

t.test(df_size_200$Gaussian, df_table4$Gaussian)$p.value
t.test(df_size_200$Laplace, df_table4$Laplace)$p.value
t.test(df_size_200$Cauchy, df_table4$Cauchy)$p.value
t.test(df_size_200$Pareto, df_table4$Pareto)$p.value
t.test(df_size_200$NND, df_table4$NND)$p.value
t.test(df_size_200$SS, df_table4$SS)$p.value
```

```{r}

t.test(df_size_500$Gaussian, df_table5$Gaussian)$p.value
t.test(df_size_500$Laplace, df_table5$Laplace)$p.value
t.test(df_size_500$Cauchy, df_table5$Cauchy)$p.value
t.test(df_size_500$Pareto, df_table5$Pareto)$p.value
t.test(df_size_500$NND, df_table5$NND)$p.value
t.test(df_size_500$SS, df_table5$SS)$p.value
```

## Exemplo de visualização

```{r}

boxplot(df_size_500$Gaussian, df_table5$Gaussian,
        names = c("minha sim", "artigo"),
        main = "Comparação - Gaussian Size 500")

```

```{r}

boxplot(df_size_500$Laplace, df_table5$Laplace,
        names = c("minha sim", "artigo"),
        main = "Comparação - Laplace Size 500")
```

```{r}

boxplot(df_size_200$Gaussian, df_table4$Gaussian,
        names = c("minha sim", "artigo"),
        main = "Comparação - Gaussian Size 200")
```

```{r}

boxplot(df_size_200$Laplace, df_table4$Laplace,
        names = c("minha sim", "artigo"),
        main = "Comparação - Laplace Size 200", 
        outline = FALSE)
```

Resultado - Parece que as simulações estão ok! Diferenças atribuídas à seed.

```{r}

install.packages("xtable")
```

```{r}

library(xtable)
```

```{r}

df_size_30 <- df_size_30  %>% select(-c(Laplace, Cauchy))
df_size_30 <- df_size_30 %>% filter(!gl %in% c(2, 3, 4, 15, 20, 50))

df_size_60 <- df_size_60  %>% select(-c(Laplace, Cauchy))
df_size_60 <- df_size_60 %>% filter(!gl %in% c(2, 3, 4, 15, 20, 50))

df_size_200 <- df_size_200  %>% select(-c(Laplace, Cauchy))
df_size_200 <- df_size_200 %>% filter(!gl %in% c(2, 3, 4, 15, 20, 50))

df_size_500 <- df_size_500  %>% select(-c(Laplace, Cauchy))
df_size_500 <- df_size_500 %>% filter(!gl %in% c(2, 3, 4, 15, 20, 50))


```

```{r}

print(xtable(df_size_30, caption = "Resultado Simulações de Monte Carol para 30 Samples"), type = "latex")
```

```{r}

print(xtable(df_size_60, caption = "Resultado Simulações de Monte Carol para 60 Samples"), type = "latex")
```

```{r}

print(xtable(df_size_200, caption = "Resultado Simulações de Monte Carol para 200 Samples"), type = "latex")
```

```{r}

print(xtable(df_size_500, caption = "Resultado Simulações de Monte Carol para 500 Samples"), type = "latex")
```
